Works Cited

Battilana, Julie, and Silvia Dorado. "Building Sustainable Hybrid Organizations: The Case of Commercial Microfinance Organizations." Academy of Management Journal, vol. 53, no. 6, 2010, pp. 1419-40.
Espeland, Wendy Nelson, and Michael Sauder. "Rankings and Reactivity: How Public Measures Recreate Social Worlds." American Journal of Sociology 113.1 (2007): 1-40.
Gehman, Joel, et al. "Finding Theory–Method Fit: A Comparison of Three Qualitative Approaches to Theory Building." Journal of Management Inquiry, vol. 27, no. 3, 2018, pp. 284-300.
Granovetter, Mark S. "The Strength of Weak Ties." American Journal of Sociology 78.6 (1973): 1360-80.
Meyer, John W., and Brian Rowan. "Institutionalized Organizations: Formal Structure as Myth and Ceremony." American Journal of Sociology 83.2 (1977): 340-63.
Ostrom, Elinor. Governing the Commons: The Evolution of Institutions for Collective Action. Cambridge UP, 1990.
Suchman, Mark C. "Managing Legitimacy: Strategic and Institutional Approaches." Academy of Management Review, vol. 20, no. 3, 1995, pp. 571-610.
Swidler, Ann. "Culture in Action: Symbols and Strategies." American Sociological Review 51.2 (1986): 273-86.
Weick, Karl E. Sensemaking in Organizations. Sage, 1995.
